LanguageData.EnhancedIdeology.CertaintyDriftRate.Tip: How fast a pawn's certainty moves toward its target each day. Higher = faith reacts faster to circumstances. Makes for more dynamic beliefs.
LanguageData.EnhancedIdeology.RelationalMaxRange.Tip: The most that a pawn's opinion of their co-religionists can raise or lower their target certainty.
LanguageData.EnhancedIdeology.PracticeMaxRange.Tip: The most that precept moods (from rituals, veneration, taboos, etc) can raise or lower target certainty.
LanguageData.EnhancedIdeology.CrisisThreshold.Tip: When a pawn's certainty falls below this, they may have a crisis-of-faith breakdown. Higher = more crises.
LanguageData.EnhancedIdeology.ConversionPace.Tip: How quickly pawns abandon a poorly-fitting faith on their own, relative to default. Higher = spontaneous conversions are more likely.
LanguageData.EnhancedIdeology.ConversionCertaintyKnoc: When a moral guide wins a conversion debate but doesn't immediately flip the pawn, their certainty is multiplied by this. 1x = an 80%-certain pawn stays at 80%; 0.8x = an 80%-certain pawn drops to 64%. Lower = conversion attempts more impactful.
LanguageData.EnhancedIdeology.ConvictionDecayRate.Tip: How much conviction strength all precepts lose per quadrum. Note that 100% conviction is at a precept average of 20, max is 50. Higher = stronger need for reinforcing beliefs.
How strongly a pawn opposes the stance at the opposite extreme of an issue, as a fraction of their conviction. At 100%, a pawn with Cannibalism: Disapproved 12 has opinion -12 of Cannibalism: Required (ravenous). 0% = indifferent to opposing stances; 100% = equal and opposite to their support for their own at the furthest extreme precept.
LanguageData.EnhancedIdeology.ConversionStancePull.Ti: How much harder a successful conversion attempt (a moral guide's directed action) pushes a pawn's beliefs than an ordinary conversion attempt. Higher = faster conversions.
How far a single won argument moves belief on the issue, relative to default. Shifts both the precept and the conviction in that precept simultaneously. Higher = each won debate persuades more. Leads to faster conversions.
LanguageData.EnhancedIdeology.ConversionOpinionMultip: How much a pawn's opinion of someone trying to change their precept amplifies the effect. At 1x and opinion +100, both the certainty knock and the belief pull are doubled. At 0x, opinion has no effect. Not used when Peer Pressure is installed — that mod's own multiplier setting takes over instead.
When loading a vanilla or pre-mod save, pawns whose certainty is below this have their beliefs seeded to at least this target instead of zero. Prevents a pawn with 0% certainty from being left with no convictions whatsoever.
LanguageData.EnhancedIdeology.DebugInteractionWorkers: Enables debug logging for interaction workers when dev mode is active. I suggest you leave this off unless debugging Enhanced Ideology specifically.
